title: LightCarbon LCR018-D aero endurance frameset page
notes: Specification table: max tire clearance 700C×38C (width as measured), with no separate 1× or 2× tire limit. Max compatible chainrings: Shimano 2× 54-40T or 1× 46T; SRAM 2× 56-43T or 1× 54T. Routing diagram includes a front-derailleur path. LightCarbon describes the frame as purpose-built for endurance and markets 32C, 35C and 38C tire choices.
